title: Exceptional tree list update after the fire
summary: As of September 9, 2026, members were asked to pick exceptional trees from the list, confirm their logins, and start measuring them. The chair said trees that died or burned in the fire will be removed from the list through an ordinance update, and is doing tree value assessments so families can recover more from the lawsuit. The list changes will go to the county council together with the tree removals.

timeline.text: The chair is doing tree value assessments so families can get more money back from the lawsuit.
The chair said trees that died or burned in the fire will be removed from the list through an ordinance update.
Members are asked to confirm once they have their logins and then start measuring their trees.
Members were asked to pick trees from the exceptional tree list to measure.
The exceptional tree changes will go to the county council together with the tree removals.
The chair wants to update the list for lost trees so all list changes can be made at one time.
The committee may store exceptional tree data in Tree Plotter, an app the County already pays for, at no added cost.
The chair plans a December site visit so members can learn how to measure exceptional trees.
